title: Trump dodged Yemen's plea for military support against Houthis: Report
summary_full: President Trump did not commit US forces to aid Yemen against the Houthis.  Yemeni President Alimi sought American backing for his government's efforts.  US officials met Houthi representatives in Oman, discussing a ceasefire.  Trump reportedly called off planned airstrikes against Houthi targets.  The conflict has caused significant casualties and displacement within Yemen.
